initial_findings: Video Growth Agent already claims AI-video production, growth systems and original digital-IP incubation as one domain, while the ai-self-media-commercialization package is isolated as a future-import reference package despite already containing account positioning, monetization and advertiser strategy.

UAOS currently mirrors two Video business identities/cursors, video:ai-self-media-commercialization and video-growth:main, while the child repository separately owns projects/ai-self-media-commercialization and projects/pilot-002 business state.

The existing AgenticStudio supports coarse wave concurrency and review panels but readiness requires all lower-wave work to complete, so it cannot express explicit partial dependencies or general competitive/adjudication relations.
The existing specialist model correctly forbids peer chat and uses artifact handoffs; the missing abstraction is an explicit domain-owned work graph rather than more persistent agents.
